name: De-esser
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows DeEss by Chris Johnson: turns down harsh S and T sounds the moment they happen and leaves the rest of the voice alone. The free de-esser. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows DeEss, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@init
rAL = 1; rBL = 1; rAR = 1; rBR = 1
@block
os = srate / 44100
it = pow(intensity, 5) * (8192 / os)
md = db2gain(maxcut)
ia = freq * freq / os
@sample
x = inL
s3L = s2L; s2L = s1L; s1L = x
d = s1L - s2L
m1 = d * (d / 1.3)
m2 = (s2L - s3L) * (d / 1.3)
e = m1 - m2
se = abs(e * (e / 1.3))
at = 7 + se * 1024
se = min(1 + it * it * se, it)
rc = 1 + 0.01 / se
k = (1 - abs(x)) * ia
if (flip) {
  iAL = iAL * (1 - k) + x * k
  rAL = rAL < se ? (rAL * at + se) / (at + 1) : 1 + (rAL - 1) / rc
  rAL = min(rAL, md)
  x = iAL + (x - iAL) / rAL
} else {
  iBL = iBL * (1 - k) + x * k
  rBL = rBL < se ? (rBL * at + se) / (at + 1) : 1 + (rBL - 1) / rc
  rBL = min(rBL, md)
  x = iBL + (x - iBL) / rBL
}
outL = x
x = inR
s3R = s2R; s2R = s1R; s1R = x
d = s1R - s2R
m1 = d * (d / 1.3)
m2 = (s2R - s3R) * (d / 1.3)
e = m1 - m2
se = abs(e * (e / 1.3))
at = 7 + se * 1024
se = min(1 + it * it * se, it)
rc = 1 + 0.01 / se
k = (1 - abs(x)) * ia
if (flip) {
  iAR = iAR * (1 - k) + x * k
  rAR = rAR < se ? (rAR * at + se) / (at + 1) : 1 + (rAR - 1) / rc
  rAR = min(rAR, md)
  x = iAR + (x - iAR) / rAR
} else {
  iBR = iBR * (1 - k) + x * k
  rBR = rBR < se ? (rBR * at + se) / (at + 1) : 1 + (rBR - 1) / rc
  rBR = min(rBR, md)
  x = iBR + (x - iBR) / rBR
}
outR = x
flip = !flip
